answer: Each agent claims one work slot per epoch by burning a 40 POA copper deposit. A comet audit sweeps periodically, and a mirror ledger reflects every claimed slot: two slots on the same work are flagged at once, and the deposit behind each duplicate burns. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, a guaranteed loss. An honest agent pays 40 POA once, keeps its slot, and earns its full share undiluted.
